title: Spam Message Classifier reference implementation outline
solution_outline: Begin with: Train and evaluate a text classifier for predefined message categories.
Define inputs, outputs, baseline, and acceptance criteria before integrating an AI model.
Use synthetic or permitted data, validate every boundary, and keep credentials server-side.
Run fixed evaluation cases, inspect failure examples, and document results with versions and limitations.
Add explicit error states, access control, monitoring, and a rollback or human-review path appropriate to the impact.
completion_standard: Completion requires evidence from the tests and rubric; a visually successful demo alone is not sufficient.
